title: Vickers Wellington BK491
memorial_details: 1) Churchyard wall mounted, slate backboard supporting a metal plaque with image of a Wellington at top centre. Inscription in relief. 2) (Plaque was initially located a few metres away and attached directly to the south-east wall of the adjacent Village Hall).
inscription: IN MEMORY OF / (4 Names) / Who lost their lives when Wellington BK491 of 26 OTU left Little Horwood / and crashed in a field of Nash End Farm at 18.55 hrs, 30th December 1943. / Dedicated on 30th November 2013 / Loved in life / Honoured in death /Cherished in memory.
